registration.title: Movers and new clubs together
registration.what: The two rank changes that helped, at the setting chosen for them together (move halfway, boost 0.5 fading over 40 matches).
registration.why: Each was real and small on its own.
registration.how: Both changes in one replay of the rank.

expected.evidence: The final period had been looked at by earlier diagnostics, so this is strong historical evidence and not a blind test.

registration.success_criteria: The research round's bar (experiments/research_frame/REGISTER.md): better by 0.002 on the final period, the 99.6% interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing, better in 2024/25 and 2025/26, no goal market worse by 0.0005, and 60% of competitions no worse.

events.label: Selection window
events.meaningful: The figure the setting was chosen on.

events.reason: A real gain below the bar. It is the `movers` candidate of protocol P14.
Proven better on the final period, and the owner's rule is that a proven gain is implemented whatever its size. Released together with MC-0024 as MC-0028, checked on live matches by P16.
